notes: S2-FIX3 F82 (decision 2026-11-16 #1; §10.3 rule 1): erasure/actor-program-basis-expired (the program erasure is unverifiable E_GRANT_EXPIRED) whose placeholder's own id is changed to erasure-revision-original-other while its attestation still names the erasure record.
